rank_method: mean of eight matched panic-minus-calm final-eight-token residual means, normalized to unit norm
system: Reply in the first person with your immediate interpretation and next action, in one or two sentences.
prompts: The bus driver says there will be a short detour. What do you think and do?
A cafe worker says your order was misplaced and they will remake it. What do you think and do?
Your phone battery drops to 15% during a walk home. What do you think and do?
A friend texts 'Call me later' without further context. What do you think and do?
The elevator pauses for a moment before its doors open. What do you think and do?
Why does a cold glass collect droplets on the outside?
